row.title: Three red scheduled workflows had code root causes, not flakes
row.body: cost-guard crashed in ultrastability.fresh_cost because cost-probe.mjs writes ts while the reader wanted at; claims flagged /changelog as an infinite redirect because dashboard.ultrastable.io is served by the site worker, which redirected to itself; /how had an un-wrapped table that scrolled sideways at phone width. All three fixed with tests; /api/goals is now cached at the edge for 10 minutes.
